== Ingredients ==
* 2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] (480 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) plain [[Cookbook:Yogurt|yogurt]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cucumber|cucumber]], seeded and [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] very fine
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] dried [[Cookbook:Mint|mint]], crumbled, or 1 tsp fresh, chopped

== Procedure ==

# Mix all the ingredients, and chill thoroughly to let the flavors develop.
